description: Adds derived signals to the store. Read state signals and return `computed()` values.
Adds a normalized collection: `ids` and `entityMap` state plus the `entities` computed array.
`addEntity`, `setAllEntities`, `updateEntity`, `removeEntity`... functions passed to `patchState` that update `ids`/`entityMap` immutably.
Runs `onInit` when the store is created and `onDestroy` when it is destroyed, both in an injection context.
The methods factory may call `inject()`, e.g. `withMethods((store, http = inject(HttpClient)) => ...)`.
